question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Prevents** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Prevents **means to stop something from happening or to hinder an action. (किसी चीज़ को घटित होने से रोकना या किसी कार्य में बाधा डालना) • **Example**: *Installing a good antivirus program on your computer helps prevent malicious software from infecting your system.* • The word "**prevents**" is used here to convey the idea that something is taking action to stop or hinder the occurrence of **tempests **(violent storms) and unforeseen **droughts **(lack of rainfall). Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Collides: **Comes into violent contact with something. Typically used to describe a forceful impact or collision between two objects. (किसी चीज़ के हिंसक संपर्क में आना) • **Confirms: **Affirms the truth or correctness of something. To validate or acknowledge the accuracy of a statement, fact, or belief. (किसी बात की सत्यता या शुद्धता की पुष्टि करता है) • **Contributes: **Provides something, such as effort, resources, or ideas, to a cause or project. (किसी कारण या परियोजना के लिए प्रयास, संसाधन या विचार जैसे कुछ प्रदान करता है) 3f:Tab7, The correct answer is: **Experiencing**
